Optimizely Virtual Happy Hour

📣 Heads up — registration has moved! You can now sign up for the next Happy Hour over at our Academy event page, where we keep session details, topics, and speakers up to date.

What is Happy Hour? Optimizely Virtual Happy Hour is a monthly online meetup for Optimizely's technical community. The goal is simple: bring people together to talk about Optimizely (and whatever else is going on), share knowledge, and get to know one another a little better. Nothing formal — just a relaxed space to ask questions, learn, and swap notes.

The series started as a weekly meetup during the Covid-19 pandemic to keep the community connected online. It was a great success, so we brought it back permanently on a monthly cadence. Thank you to everyone who continues to join — we look forward to many more great sessions.

When: The last Friday of every month, 8:00 AM PST / 10:00 AM CST / 11:00 AM EST

👉 Register for the next session on Academy

# Optimizely Virtual Happy Hour

📣 Heads up — registration has moved! You can now sign up for the next Happy Hour over at our [Academy event page](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/all_sessions), where we keep session details, topics, and speakers up to date.

What is Happy Hour? Optimizely Virtual Happy Hour is a monthly online meetup for Optimizely's technical community. The goal is simple: bring people together to talk about Optimizely (and whatever else is going on), share knowledge, and get to know one another a little better. Nothing formal — just a relaxed space to ask questions, learn, and swap notes.

The series started as a weekly meetup during the Covid-19 pandemic to keep the community connected online. It was a great success, so we brought it back permanently on a monthly cadence. Thank you to everyone who continues to join — we look forward to many more great sessions.

When: The last Friday of every month, 8:00 AM PST / 10:00 AM CST / 11:00 AM EST

**👉** [**Register for the next session on Academy**](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/activity/2427341-optimizely-virtual-happy-hour)
